# Third-party sources

The `third_party/tensorflow` and `third_party/kissfft` files are copied from
`rhasspy/pymicro-features` version 2.0.2, commit
`96bd69cfad79aa67697e176570d3dd87052c3def`.

They implement the TensorFlow Lite Micro audio frontend used by
micro-wake-word training. See `third_party/microfrontend.LICENSE` and the
license headers in the individual files.
